Find installer files

Usage: mole-linux installer [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --debug                  Enable debug output
      --dry-run                List installer files and change nothing
      --max-depth <MAX_DEPTH>  Directory depth to scan, 1-16 (default 2)
      --hidden                 Also scan hidden (dot) directories
      --type <TYPE>            List only one installer type: deb, rpm, appimage, pkg.tar.zst, iso, tar, zip, flatpakref
  -h, --help                   Print help
